experiments.scope: blake3-r1-prefix-v1 complete-hash ordinary collisions on 64-byte single-root-compression messages. Executes the CLAIMED construction itself: experiments/fixed.py builds the 78-instruction fixed-constant straight-line listing of proof.md section 3, encodes it to 16-byte fixed-width machine words, DECODES the encoded bytes, and executes the decoded program on the declared 256-bit-word RAM model; emitted messages must equal the certificate files byte-for-byte and the harness recomputes both digests.
experiments.hypothesis: For every organizer trial the decoded-executed fixed-constant listing emits the certified pair (distinct, 64 bytes) whose complete 1-round BLAKE3 digests are equal, and the program's internal assertion a1+b1+y = 0 mod 2^32 holds on both solved diagonals. Success probability 1 (deterministic listing; seed selects nothing); any recomputed mismatch refutes the construction.
